name: Hiroya
source:
Faction: Demon
Race: Therian 
Occupation: Boxer
Reality: 2nd-year high school student 
Hobby: Soccer
Specialty: Sprinting
Favorite Food: Meat (esp. hamburger steak)
Dislikes: Numbers

"Don't look like that. I'll figure something out."

A brusque Boxer with a slight attitude, who often tends to be harsh with Kazuha. Though he can sometimes come off as aloof, he is actually a caring person who puts his life on the line for Kazuha in the game world.

In real life, he is her childhood friend. Although they played together for years as children, after graduating from junior high, they eventually grew apart. He has been acting distant around her lately for some reason.

He is also a good friend of Kazuha’s brother, Shiki, who was the one who invited Hiroya to play Arcadia in the first place. He helps Kazuha find her brother, while at the same time protecting her after she becomes the “Almighty.” 

[From the [url=http://aksysgames.com/pcube/]official site[/url]]
